title: OffsetBias: Leveraging Debiased Data for Tuning Evaluators
authors_zh: Junsoo Park、Seungyeon Jwa、Meiying Ren、Daeyoung Kim、Sanghyuk Choi
best_for_zh: 偏好学习、奖励建模与反馈数据审计
one_line: OffsetBias releases instruction prompts, two candidate responses, and deliberately balanced evaluator labels for response comparison for bounded preference learning, reward modeling, evaluation, and audit.
OffsetBias 发布围绕其任务场景组织的候选回答比较与反馈记录，可用于有边界的偏好学习、奖励建模、评测和审计。
why: The release supports feedback learning for 裁判模型的长度与位置偏差.
inclusion_reason: Public preference, reward, or feedback data with a documented comparison contract and official release link.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LLM judges can prefer a longer, more concrete, or more familiar answer even when it is wrong or fails the instruction. OffsetBias studies this evaluator failure: select the genuinely good response rather than a response whose style exploits a judge's superficial cue.

The decision surface is an instruction and a good/bad response pair. It targets six identified content-and-style biases, while position bias is measured separately because it is not tied to a particular text pair.

语言模型裁判可能偏爱更长、更具体或更熟悉的回答，即使该回答错误或没有遵循指令。OffsetBias 研究的正是这种评估失误：应选出真正较好的回答，而非被表面线索诱导的回答。

其判定对象是一条指令与一对优劣回答，针对六种已识别的内容和文体偏差。位置偏差因不依附特定文本对而另行测量。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: OffsetBias supplies counterexamples in which the rejected answer has an attractive but misleading form—such as excess length, invented concrete detail, or an off-topic continuation—while the chosen answer follows the instruction. Its 8,504 instruction/good/bad triplets are constructed to teach a judge or reward model that critical errors override such cues; the contract is deliberately authored correctness within adversarial pairs, not a broad human-preference distribution.
OffsetBias 提供反例对：被拒回答在形式上更诱人却具有误导性，例如过长、编造具体细节或偏题续写；被选回答则遵循原指令。其 8,504 条“指令—好回答—坏回答”三元组旨在教会裁判或奖励模型：严重错误应压过这些线索。该契约是对抗式文本对中的人工设定正确性，而非广泛的人类偏好分布。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Diagnose six recurring biases with judge failures and hand-crafted EVALBIASBENCH cases. 2. Sample instructions from Alpaca, UltraChat, Evol-Instruct, and FLAN. 3. Use off-topic generation or GPT-4/Claude-3-Opus error generation to make a stylistically tempting but critically wrong response, with an existing reference or weaker-model output as the good response. 4. Remove items that both a base judge and GPT-3.5 solve, then train by adding the retained pairs to preference data and swap response order to reduce position bias.

The output is 8,504 hard pairs and an 80-case bias benchmark. Reproduction depends on the published generation prompts, filter, and response ordering; a pair's label says which response is correct for its constructed instruction.

1. 通过裁判错误和手工构造的 EVALBIASBENCH 样例诊断六类重复偏差。2. 从 Alpaca、UltraChat、Evol-Instruct 和 FLAN 抽取指令。3. 用偏题生成，或用 GPT-4、Claude-3-Opus 生成错误回答，制造文体诱人却有严重错误的回答；好回答取既有参考或较弱模型输出。4. 删除基线裁判和 GPT-3.5 都能答对的样例，将保留对加入偏好数据训练，并交换回答顺序以缓解位置偏差。

产物为 8,504 个困难回答对及一个含 80 例的偏差基准。复现依赖已发布的生成提示、过滤规则和回答顺序；标签只说明在构造出的指令下哪个回答正确。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Claim: hard counterexamples improve judge robustness rather than merely fitting ordinary preferences. The paper trains matched LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct judges with and without OffsetBias; difficulty filtering removes about 60% of generated candidates and leaves 8,504 instances. On the separate 80-case EVALBIASBENCH and other reported benchmarks, the supplemented judge improves over the human-preference-only counterpart. The result is bounded by the six designed bias families and the paper's evaluator settings.
主张：困难反例提升的是裁判鲁棒性，而不只是拟合普通偏好。论文以是否加入 OffsetBias 为唯一差异，训练配对的 LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct 裁判；难度过滤去除了约 60% 的生成候选，最终保留 8,504 例。在独立的 80 例 EVALBIASBENCH 及其他报告基准上，加入数据的裁判优于只用人工偏好数据的对应模型。该结果受六种预设偏差家族和论文评测设置限制。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Previous debiasing commonly targets a single cue such as length or answer order. OffsetBias first names six failure patterns, then creates pairs where the wrong answer intentionally carries the favored cue and survives a difficulty filter. The contribution is bias-directed training data plus a small meta-evaluation set; it does not make a judge immune to unknown biases or replace factual verification.
较早的去偏工作常只针对长度或回答顺序等单一线索。OffsetBias 先归纳六类失效模式，再构造“错误回答刻意携带受偏爱线索、且能通过难度过滤”的文本对。其贡献是面向偏差的训练数据和小型元评测集；它不会使裁判免于未知偏差，也不能替代事实核验。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The six bias categories were derived from the authors' error analysis and EVALBIASBENCH has only 80 hand-crafted cases. A gain on those patterns may not cover new prompt attacks, languages, or domain-specific errors; add target-domain adversarial checks.

Bad responses are generated largely by GPT-4 and Claude-3-Opus, then filtered by models. This may transfer generator artifacts into the labels, so inspect whether a downstream judge learns to recognize the construction style instead of the critical error.

六类偏差来自作者的错误分析，而 EVALBIASBENCH 只有 80 个手工样例。对这些模式的提升未必覆盖新的提示攻击、其他语言或领域错误；应加入目标领域的对抗检查。

坏回答主要由 GPT-4 与 Claude-3-Opus 生成，再由模型过滤，可能把生成器痕迹传入标签。因此应检查下游裁判学到的是严重错误，还是构造文本的文体。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use OffsetBias as an augmentation and stress test for a pairwise text judge. Mix it with ordinary preference data, randomize answer order, and report accuracy by the six named bias types as well as target tasks. Do not use its chosen labels as general user taste or as evidence that a response is factually correct outside the constructed pair.
适用于为成对文本裁判添加训练数据并进行压力测试。应与普通偏好数据混合、随机化回答顺序，并按六类已命名偏差和目标任务分别报告准确率。不要把优选标签视作普遍用户口味，也不要据此断言构造文本对之外的回答事实正确。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Six bias types include length, concreteness, and empty-reference bias.
  2. EVALBIASBENCH has 80 author-agreed adversarial cases.
  3. OffsetBias has 8,504 retained instruction/good/bad triplets.
  4. About 60% of generated candidates are removed as too easy or poor.
  5. Position is handled by response swapping, not one content-bias label.

1. 六类偏差包括长度、具体性和空指代偏差。
  2. EVALBIASBENCH 有 80 个经作者一致确认的对抗样例。
  3. OffsetBias 保留 8,504 条“指令—好回答—坏回答”三元组。
  4. 约 60% 生成候选因太容易或质量差被删除。
  5. 位置问题靠交换回答顺序处理，而非一个内容偏差标签。
